lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in approximately four vertical columns and four horizontal rows within the visible frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect to form a grid-like pattern, with white circular blobs localized at the junctions of these bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper dorsal flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circular reddish-brown mark or lesion is located on the upper flank, superior to the first and second gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae individuals (remoras) are visible: one attached near the ventral junction of the pectoral fin and the body, and another positioned on the lateral surface of the pectoral fin.
